column1: # Guideline path moves, cumulative across releases.
# A project that skipped releases is carried forward correctly, because every
# move ever made is listed here. Append rows, never edit or delete them.
# Matching is done on the old path as a whole token, so it also covers absolute
# paths, ../developer-guidelines/ prefixes and bare file names.
# Longest old path is applied first — order in this file does not matter.
